name: oled15_ssd1351
title: Waveshare 1.5-inch RGB OLED on an SSD1351
description: A 128x128 colour OLED on SPI, written only: seven contacts in a row and the same seven on a PH2.0 socket; a regulator makes 3.3 V and a boost converter the voltage of the panel
notes: BS on the back chooses the SPI: 0 for four wires with DC, as it comes, 1 for three wires with DC to ground. The level of the lines is that of VCC, Waveshare says: 3.3 V lines want 3.3 V on VCC.

power.name: 3V3
power.why: U1, an RT9193-33; U2, an SX1308, boosts it for the panel.

J1.type: PH2.0 socket, 7 pins, on the back

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: The back: VCC GND DIN CLK CS DC RST from the top, beside the holes and beside the socket; SSD1351U3 on the ribbon of the panel.

schematic.source: Waveshare, 1.5inch_RGB_OLED_Module_Schematic.pdf (https://files.waveshare.com/upload/a/a3/1.5inch_RGB_OLED_Module_Schematic.pdf): P1 from RES at 1 to VCC at 7, J1 the other way; and its wiki page: 128x128, 26.855 x 26.855 mm, 3.3 V or 5 V. Not tried.

start.source: What the SSD1351 driver starts with. At which corner of this module the first pixel lies is not tried.
